  tail: **Why this works:** | - If the process crashes during writing, only the temporary file is corrupted, leaving the original report intact | - `os.replace()` is atomic on both Linux and Windows, so the target file either has the old content or the new content, never a partial write | - Writing to the same directory ensures the rename is truly atomic (cross-directory renames may not be atomic) | **Tests:** All 2 existing tests pass without modification.
